IS : 8422 (Part VIII) - 1977 




Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2000 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR PISTON RINGS FOR IC ENGINES 

PART VIII NARROW LAND SLOTTED OIL CONTROL RINGS 
FROM 50 UP TO 200 mm NOMINAL DIAMETER 

DARINGS 



1. Scope — Specifies the dimensions, tolerances, tangential loads and other details of D-rings (narrow 
land slotted oil control rings) from 50 up to 200 mm nominal diameter for internal combustion engines. 

2. Dimensions and Tolerances — Shall be as given in Table 1 read along with Fig. 1 . 




DETAIL A 

SHOWING CHAMFERING OF 
INTERNAL EDGES (Kt) 

Ai! dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 NARROW LAND SLOTTED OIL CONTROL RING (D-RING) 

2,1 Arrangement ofS/ots — ShaW be according to Fig. 2. 
3. Designation — Shall include: 

a) Type of ring ; 

b) Nominal diameter, c/i; 

c) Axial width, h^; 

d) Number of this standard; 

e) Material symbol; 

f) Manufacturing process; 

g) Whether internally bevelled (IF); and 
h) Type of coating. 

Example: 

A narrow land slotted oil control ring (D-ring) having nominal diameter di=90 mm, axial width 
hj^^5 mm, made of alloyed cast iron (A4) and phosphated on all sides (P) shall be designated as: 

D-Ring 90 X 5 IS : 8422 (Part VIII) A4 P

FIG. 2 ARRANGEMENT OF SLOTS 



4. General Requirements — Shall be as given in IS : 5791-1977. 

5. Marking — The rings which are to be fitted in a particular direction shall be marked with the word TOP' 
on the top-sides of the rings. For other markings reference should be made to IS : 5791 -1 977. 

5.1 iSi Certification Maridng — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

EXPLAN ATO R Y NOTE 

This Standard is one of the series of Indian Standards on piston ring dimensions, tangential force, 
etc. IS : 5791 is a necessary adjunct to this standard which gives details of materials, surface finish, gap 
types and sizes, surface coatings, manufacturing processes, etc. 

In the preparation of this standard due consideration has been given to the prevalent sizes in the 
industry. It is recommended that for new designs, only the sizes given in this standard be used. 

In the preparation of this standard assistance has been derived from DIN 70947 'Piston rings for 
automotive engineering, D-rings, narrow land drain oil control rings, 50 up to 200 mm nominal diameter, 
issued by DIN Deutsches Institutfiir Normung. 



Printed at Sree Saraswaty Press Ltd, Calcutta, India
